_note: The prescribed amount a specified employee's income under "Salaries" by way of monetary payment, from one or more employers, must exceed; a benefit or amenity is a perquisite only for a specified employee, or a director or substantial-interest holder of a company employer (S2 s.17(1)(c); 1961 s.17(2)(iii); D-113; rulebook PERQ-SPECEMP-001). The measure is salary.monetaryincome; the perquisite nodes test "exceeds" against this amount, strictly. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.17, "₹ 400000" (Gazette 271092, p.1549). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3C, "four lakh rupees", inserted by G.S.R. 555(E) of 18-8-2025 in force on publication, after the Finance Act, 2025 s.9(a) made the amount prescribed from 1-4-2026 (assessment year 2026-27). Every regime. The row gates the items whose perquisite.arrangement is EMPLOYER_PROVIDED — the s.17(1)(c) benefit or amenity — tested per item; the threshold is read with no item (W-154b).
